knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The walk-through confirms scope and identifies hazards, which is the first control in the routine.
Unknown material is outside routine scope. Stop, protect people and escalate.
The order of controls starts with removing the hazard where authorised, then isolating it, then procedure and PPE.

practicalCriteria: Completes a scope check and a full room scan before opening any product.
Identifies at least six hazards in a supervised simulated bathroom and prioritises three.
Stops work and escalates when a simulated unknown sharp or uncontrolled material is introduced.
Records pre-existing damage before work starts.
passRule: All stop-work criteria met and at least six hazards identified with three prioritised, observed by an assessor. The quiz is not evidence of practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation sheet for the simulated bathroom
stopWorkCriteria: Unknown sharp or uncontrolled biological material
Exposed live electrical part or damaged fitting in contact with water
Unknown chemical or request to mix products
